title: Grateful Dead Live at Gym, S.U.N.Y. (early) on 1970-10-31
lineage: Dat (Sony R500) -> Apogee Ensemble -> Peak Pro 7 -> AIFFMastering Info:AIFF -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/

ai_review.summary: Good soundboard capture of a memorable dual‑show performance with Jerry and Mickey, though the band was a tad sloppy on a few tunes.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as a solid soundboard source that cleanly presents the combined early and late shows from the S.U.S.B. concert. Reviewers love seeing Jerry Garcia and drummer Mickey Hart together with NRPS, but note a slight sloppiness on some numbers. Overall the show is viewed as very enjoyable despite the minor performance hiccups.

ai_rating.rationale: Both reviewers gave high marks (4‑5 stars) and highlighted a strong performance with only mild sloppiness; recording quality is described as good but without detailed technical data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the recording as "good"/"very good" with no specific flaws mentioned.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The tape merges an early set (ending in UJB) and a later ticketed show, giving the release an uneven but historically interesting flow.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His presence is highlighted as a memorable part of the night, cementing the experience for the reviewer.
band_member_comments.Drums: Mickey's drumming is noted positively, though the band was described as "a tad sloppy" on a couple of tunes.
